test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

At times, David behaves in a very __obdurate __manner to kids.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"obdurate"** means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action. (जिद्दी) • **Example: **Despite the pleas from his friends, he remained obdurate in his decision to leave the city. • **"Obstinate"** also means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or action, often despite attempts to persuade one to do so. (हठी) • **Example: **He was too obstinate to admit that he was wrong. • Hence, we can infer that "obdurate" is synonymous with "obstinate". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Trusting **(विश्वास करने वाला): Showing or tending to have a belief in a person's honesty or sincerity; not suspicious. • **Example:** She was so trusting that she lent him her car without hesitation. • **Amiable **(मिलनसार): Having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner. • **Example: **He was an amiable host, making everyone feel at home. • **Envious** (ईर्ष्यालु): Feeling or showing envy; wanting what someone else has. • **Example:** She was envious of her friend's new job. 116:Td9b,
